purpose._: Locked expanded Home 2026-09-06 (Zillow-shaped after Redfin cut). Full-bleed search. Stacked house carousels. Illustrated doors. No Atlas, map block, town ledger, or market essay on home.
purpose.job: Turn someone who typed a money query into a search they can act on. Search is the Stage action. Photographed house rails and Buy/Sell/Invest doors follow.
purpose.primaryAction: Search city, community, or address. See all homes opens the Field.
purpose.audience: A buyer or looker at the top of the funnel who does not yet know the towns. NOT a seller (they arrive on /sell).
questionsItMustAnswer: What is for sale here right now?
Can I buy, sell, or invest from here?

alsoWins: homes for sale bend redmond sisters sunriver
searchIntent.whyThisPageCanWin: It publishes live inventory and a working search on one crawlable branded door. Search owns the inventory SERP; home owns the brand.
searchIntent.whatItOwesSEO: One H1 Ryan Realty, Bend. Town and resort names as real doors. JSON-LD that matches the visible figures.

dataAvailable: live active listings with photo, price, address, beds/baths/sqft, badges we already encode
Google reviews, the three brokers, the approved Bend flyover clip

priorMark.note: Set by a different evaluator against shots that no longer exist; not comparable to this scale. On this evaluator's scale the SITE-M1 item moved the page 60 (round 1) to 74 (round 2) to 77 (round 3), all of the rise in the brokers section.

fixedFromThisPass: Brokers section (SITE-M1): compact table on the homepage only; three faces on a shared hairline shelf, name, role, OR license, Call / Text / Book rows on a subgrid, one 390 screen (was one broker per row, third below the fold).

Cutouts dissolve into cream on three sides (mask), no box or fill behind a portrait; role line and OUR BROKERS eyebrow restored; two-line name row keeps the license rows on one baseline; the phone number prints once per broker.
Save hearts on every rail card and the featured-community dots rendered as empty bordered squares (single-class selectors lost to .v3 .v3-btn); rescoped under .v3 so they render as drawn.
Record shots now render the Old Mill hero (the remote place hero does not load in the capture sandbox; served from the local canonical file) with the cookie banner dismissed.
openRaise: Footer skyline: object-fit cover in a fixed 10rem band over-scales at 1440 (ridgeline only); use object-fit contain on cream or a width-scaled band height so 1440 shows what 375 shows.
Rails: the same house (3027 Polarstar Avenue) leads both the nearby rail and the price-cuts rail; exclude keys used by a later row when building railRows.
Rails: three consecutive sections of one form (eyebrow, heading, cards, see-all); vary one row's form.
Footer: 30-row Markets column beside empty width; columns: 2 (3 at 1200 and up).
